# AI Agents Working File — Smart Straps

## Instructions *(Fixed — Do Not Edit or Delete)*

This is the AI Agents Working File for Smart Straps. It is the dedicated knowledge repository for the AI Agents – Smart Straps project — one of four Smart Straps Claude projects (Goals, Strategy – Smart Straps, Planning – Smart Straps, AI Agents – Smart Straps).

This file should contain only information that is specific and directly relevant to the AI Agents project and its work. Its purpose is to carry forward useful, specialised context that future chats within the AI Agents project can draw on — reducing the need to re-establish background, and ensuring each new session picks up with continuity and depth.

Information relevant to all projects belongs in Smart Straps.md. Information specific to other projects belongs in their respective working files.

## Migration Note

The legacy Gemini Master Doc (the predecessor to the current central knowledge base) did not contain task logs, completed-action records, or workflow outputs — those are the natural domain of this AI Agents project but were not generated under the Gemini system. Universal business context, operator working style, and operational rules that AI agents need to reference live in Smart Straps.md.

## Operational Rules Relevant to Agent Execution

- Fulfillment is currently handled entirely by Bradley
- No warehouse — fulfilled from home
- **Outsourcing trigger:** once daily fulfillment exceeds one hour, outsourcing is triggered immediately. Any agent monitoring or logging fulfilment workload should flag when the daily one-hour threshold is being approached or breached
- Marketing is the current bottleneck; product sourcing, Shopify operations, and order fulfilment are functional and not the constraint — agent execution capacity is best directed at marketing tasks first
